parsed.explanation: The dichotomy is invalid as stated: V={c} with c>0 is a third possibility, realized by f(x)=x+c. More importantly for L5.3, the proof never derives g(x)≥0; it only records g(x)>−x. A short missing argument repairs this: iterating (3) gives f^n(t)=t+n g(t)>0 for every n, which is impossible if g(t)<0. After adding that sentence, V⊆{0,c}; the constant-positive case must then be separated from the mixed case.
